system.name: heyDominik Instagram Growth OS
system.outcome_boundary: $20k+ is a target, not a guarantee; live revenue remains NO_EVENT until attributed payment evidence exists.

skills.name: Offer Explorer
process: Run a 12-question Socratic offer interview
Define ICP, urgent problem, present alternative, transformation, vehicle, proof, friction, and urgency
Analyze up to 100 permissioned ICP comments and competitor offers when supplied or connector-authorized
Separate observed demand from inferred unmet transformation gaps
Draft tripwire, core, and premium ladders with economics and validation gates
success_metric: each price tied to delivery economics and a test
one offer selected for the next step
skills.automation_advantage: Processes large evidence sets consistently and generates meaning-distinct ladders without treating price bands as proven demand.
skills.external_boundary: No Reddit/competitor scraping or market contact without an authorized source and receipt.

skills.name: ICP & Message Clarifier
process: Extract buyer, desired change, mechanism, proof, and low-friction next step
Generate 20 meaning-distinct bios
Score clarity, evidence match, specificity, readability, and CTA friction
Reject fabricated proof and hard asks unsupported by trust
Select three variants for a declared live test
success_metric: cold reader can identify who/outcome/proof/next step in 2-5 seconds
all variants fit the supplied limit
skills.automation_advantage: Explores 20 alternatives and applies the same evidence rubric without pretending its score predicts conversion.
skills.external_boundary: No profile edit or link change without approval.

skills.name: Hook & Topic Engine
process: Confirm offer, trust, and profile gates are ready
Calculate account-relative outliers when real metrics exist
Cluster topic, verbal hook, visual hook, format, and audience signal
Identify evidence-backed gaps
Generate 30 cards with 0.5-second clarity, three-second curiosity, B-roll/face handoff, caption hierarchy, and Trial/feed variants
success_metric: 30 cards trace to ICP and offer
skills.automation_advantage: Compares many captured examples, detects repeated structures, and produces a controlled test bank faster than manual teardown.
skills.external_boundary: No scraping, downloading others' media, or publishing without rights and approval.

skills.name: Profile Auditor
input: dated profile screenshots or authorized browser capture
process: Run a cold-viewer 2-5 second proxy
OCR visible text when a vision tool is available
Score name/bio, highlights, covers, pins, feed coherence, proof, binge path, and one-link path
Cite every score to visible evidence or MISSING
Prioritize fixes by funnel impact and effort
success_metric: top three fixes map to the broken handoff
skills.automation_advantage: Applies repeatable OCR, contrast, and information-architecture checks across every visible profile element.
skills.external_boundary: A handle alone is not authorization for private access; request screenshots or use an approved public browser capture.

skills.name: Funnel Diagnostician
process: Check offer clarity first
Inspect attraction through non-follower evidence
Compute profile-visit, follow, DM, call, sale, and revenue handoff ratios when denominators exist
Inspect profile and trust evidence before naming causality
Check offer visibility
Name one breaking point and three fixes in repair order
skills.automation_advantage: Recomputes the same funnel handoffs daily and catches leaks without being distracted by vanity metrics.
skills.external_boundary: Insights API pulls require an authorized Meta connection; otherwise use exports.

skills.name: Gap Matrix Builder
process: Define observable Personality and Production anchors
Score each competitor with cited examples
Plot a 2x2 or continuous map
Identify under-served combinations rather than merely empty space
Recommend a gap the creator can authentically sustain
success_metric: 10 competitors or explicit smaller sample caveat
gap matches creator capability and audience need
three tests can invalidate the recommendation
skills.automation_advantage: Normalizes a larger competitor set and detects clusters while preserving evidence for each placement.
skills.external_boundary: Vision embeddings are optional and must identify model/source; no phantom CLIP analysis.

skills.name: Trust Content Reformer
process: Audit voice, format, gap, opinion, proof, and AI-slop
Extract the truthful premise
Write a creator-specific voiceover
Place face cutaways only where identity or proof matters
Add high-contrast captions with selective underlines
Produce Trial Reel and feed variants
success_metric: muted and audio-on versions both coherent
variants differ by a declared test
skills.automation_advantage: Transforms an existing idea into several native trust surfaces while preserving a trace to source material.
skills.external_boundary: Default output is a script/edit plan. Voice cloning or synthetic face generation requires explicit consent and rights.

skills.name: Compliance Guard
process: Classify channel, jurisdiction, category, and commercial relationship
Scan regulated goods, health/supplement/GLP-1/weight-loss, finance, housing, personal attributes, spam, IP, disclosure, and watermark risks
Route health claims through claim-safe-health-marketing
Separate policy risk, legal risk, recommendation eligibility, and hygiene
Return PASS/HOLD/BLOCKED with compliant rewrite and human-review lane
success_metric: current official policy source date recorded
skills.automation_advantage: Scans every asset consistently and routes category-specific review before generation rather than after a reach failure.
skills.external_boundary: Not legal or medical advice; regulated-category launch requires qualified human review.

skills.name: Monetization Linker
process: Select one primary link and conversion event
Map content promise to landing promise to CTA
Design a tool-neutral comment/DM fulfillment flow with consent and opt-out
Use a calculator only when inputs and claims are auditable
Draft Framer build brief, ManyChat mapping JSON, and cohort outline only when relevant
Define attribution and revenue receipt
success_metric: every CTA traces to the offer
sales and collected revenue captured separately
skills.automation_advantage: Maintains message and event continuity across content, link, DM, call, and payment while generating implementation-ready drafts.
skills.external_boundary: Outputs drafts by default; Framer, ManyChat, CRM, DM, or payment-system writes require approval and a verified schema.

skills.name: Sprint Executor
process: Set an eight-week baseline and one primary funnel objective
Plan four Reels per week unless capacity requires less
Pair each premise with Trial and feed testing where available
Collect daily evidence and weekly human feedback
Change one variable per test
Run Funnel Diagnostician weekly
Stop, continue, or double down using declared thresholds
skills.automation_advantage: Maintains the experiment ledger, generates bounded revisions, and prevents daily feedback from dissolving into untracked taste changes.
skills.external_boundary: No auto-posting, outreach, or creator feedback messages without approval.
